name: Media Contextual Cropping with image_widget_crop Plugin
description: Provides a plugin for using Image_widget_crop in contextual crop.
project_description: Adapter that plugs Image Widget Crop in as the cropping UI for the Media Contextual Crop API. It ships a single MediaContextualCrop plugin (id image_widget_crop, target field image_crop) extending MediaContextualCropPluginBase, plus hook_form_alter/after_build tweaks that adapt the Image Widget Crop widget for the override (per-usage) context and a small CSS library fixing the crop vertical tabs inside the WYSIWYG media dialog. It has no configuration of its own beyond native Image Widget Crop setup, and is only useful together with a use-case module such as Media Contextual Cropping Embed or Media Contextual Cropping Field Formatter. The 2.0.x branch tracks media_contextual_crop 2.2.x, adds embed context to limit ghost crops, and drops Drupal 9 support.
